card.text: Explore Mathilde with NEAR imagery, measured partial elevation, and a published visualization shape.

introduction.text: Mathilde is a dark, slowly rotating asteroid scarred by enormous impact craters. NEAR photographed part of it during a brief flyby in 1997. This published visualization shape includes estimates for the unseen side and shadowed crater floors; those areas were not measured.

normal.title: MSI partial mosaic
normal.summary: Only part of the surface is photographed; shadows and seams remain. The unseen shape is modeled and image gaps are marked.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 26.4 km sphere, with unobserved values withheld. The display shape has modeled terrain.
